ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio (~4:1); high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels occupy approximately 80% of the visible ventral area, with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the peduncle insertion and along the trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity region across the central span of both lobes; a prominent, low-intensity (black) anchor-shaped region at the median notch/peduncle interface; dispersed low-intensity punctate mottling visible on the distal posterior of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide U-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 115-125 degrees; shallow penetration depth relative to the total fluke chord length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary; high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (saw-tooth pattern) identified on the distal 40% of the right lobe trailing edge; the left lobe edge exhibits smoother, lower-frequency variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a linear-to-concave sweep toward the distal tips (lobes taper to sharp, slightly recurved points).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of 6-10 high-intensity white punctate spots localized on the low-intensity (black) margin of the right distal lobe, likely representing barnacle attachment sites.
